referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A two-tier white header fronts a deep illustrated hero; a centered all-caps declaration and serif explanation sit above one saturated orange action. Oversized firm identity on the left, utility email above and a practice/team/awards/contact row with a bordered call action. Strong uppercase sans display, readable serif supporting statement, and compact navy navigation. The page sequence runs from identity and utility navigation to illustrated centered hero to firm mission on white toward recognition strip, three proof columns, contact-and-disclaimer footer. A dark justice illustration supplies atmosphere; below it, logo-like recognition marks and restrained orange icons create proof chapters. Only transferable composition, hierarchy and service-routing mechanics are retained.
